subject: Mathematics
title: Straight Lines
summary: Coordinate geometry starts with the distance and section formulas, the area of a triangle and the centres of a triangle (centroid, incentre, circumcentre, orthocentre).
A line can be written in slope–intercept, point–slope, two-point, intercept, normal or general form. Slopes decide parallel (m₁ = m₂) and perpendicular (m₁m₂ = −1) lines.
Distance of a point from a line, distance between parallel lines, angle between lines, family of lines through an intersection and angle bisectors are the core JEE tools.

formulas.name: Distance and section
formulas.formula: d = √((x₂ − x₁)² + (y₂ − y₁)²);  internal division m:n → ((mx₂ + nx₁)/(m + n), (my₂ + ny₁)/(m + n))

formulas.name: Area of triangle
formulas.formula: Δ = ½|x₁(y₂ − y₃) + x₂(y₃ − y₁) + x₃(y₁ − y₂)|;  area 0 ⇔ collinear

formulas.name: Centres of a triangle
formulas.formula: centroid G = ((x₁ + x₂ + x₃)/3, (y₁ + y₂ + y₃)/3);  incentre I = ((ax₁ + bx₂ + cx₃)/(a + b + c), …);  G divides OH (circumcentre O to orthocentre H) in 1:2

formulas.name: Slope
formulas.formula: m = tan θ = (y₂ − y₁)/(x₂ − x₁);  parallel m₁ = m₂;  perpendicular m₁m₂ = −1

formulas.name: Forms of a line
formulas.formula: y = mx + c;  y − y₁ = m(x − x₁);  x/a + y/b = 1;  x cos α + y sin α = p;  ax + by + c = 0 (slope −a/b)

formulas.name: Distance between parallel lines
formulas.formula: d = |c₁ − c₂|/√(a² + b²)  for ax + by + c₁ = 0 and ax + by + c₂ = 0
formulas.note: Make the x and y coefficients identical first.

formulas.name: Foot of perpendicular and image
formulas.formula: foot: (x − x₁)/a = (y − y₁)/b = −(ax₁ + by₁ + c)/(a² + b²);  image: same with −2(ax₁ + by₁ + c)/(a² + b²)

formulas.name: Family of lines
formulas.formula: L₁ + λL₂ = 0 passes through the intersection of L₁ = 0 and L₂ = 0

formulas.name: Concurrency
formulas.formula: three lines concur if the determinant |a₁ b₁ c₁; a₂ b₂ c₂; a₃ b₃ c₃| = 0

formulas.name: Angle bisectors
formulas.formula: (a₁x + b₁y + c₁)/√(a₁² + b₁²) = ±(a₂x + b₂y + c₂)/√(a₂² + b₂²)
formulas.when: Bisectors of angles between two lines.

formulas.name: Position of a point
formulas.formula: points (x₁, y₁), (x₂, y₂) are on the same side of ax + by + c = 0 if ax₁ + by₁ + c and ax₂ + by₂ + c have the same sign

topics.title: Locus
topics.explain: To find a locus, let the moving point be (h, k), write the given condition as an equation in h and k, then replace h, k by x, y.

topics.title: Shifting the origin
topics.explain: If the origin moves to (h, k) without rotation, new coordinates are X = x − h, Y = y − k. Rotation of axes by θ: x = X cos θ − Y sin θ, y = X sin θ + Y cos θ.

topics.title: Lines making a given angle
topics.explain: Lines through (x₁, y₁) making angle α with y = mx + c: slopes are (m ± tan α)/(1 ∓ m tan α).

topics.title: Pair of straight lines
topics.explain: ax² + 2hxy + by² = 0 represents two lines through the origin; angle tan θ = 2√(h² − ab)/|a + b|. They are perpendicular if a + b = 0 and coincident if h² = ab.

topics.title: Orthocentre shortcut
topics.explain: For a right-angled triangle, the orthocentre is the right-angle vertex and the circumcentre is the midpoint of the hypotenuse.

topics.title: Parametric form
topics.explain: A point at distance r from (x₁, y₁) along a line with inclination θ is (x₁ + r cos θ, y₁ + r sin θ) — handy for distances along a line.
